lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in PROGRAM EXCEPTIONS (disclaimer: 'THIS MEDICAL COVERAGE GUIDELINE APPLIES TO ALL LINES OF BUSINESS UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED IN THE PROGRAM EXCEPTIONS SECTION')

Medicare Advantage Products: NCDs Electrical Nerve Stimulators (160.7) and Deep Brain Stimulation for Essential Tremor and Parkinson's Disease (160.24) 'were reviewed' (no statement that they override)
sections_in_order: Header block (MCG number, Original Effective Date, Reviewed, Revised)
Navigation bar (Position Statement / Billing/Coding / Reimbursement / Program Exceptions / Definitions / Related Guidelines / Other / References / Updates)
criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT (about 55 lines) split under three sub-headings printed as plain lines: 'Deep Brain Stimulation', 'Responsive Neurostimulation', 'Revision/Replacement'. Key definition ('disabling, medically unresponsive tremor') is in DEFINITIONS, not the statement.
procedures_covered: DBS of globus pallidus or subthalamic nucleus (Parkinson disease; primary dystonia age >=7)
DBS for tardive dyskinesia, cluster headache, Tourette, depression, OCD, Alzheimer, anorexia, alcohol addiction, MS tremor, chronic pain, epilepsy (all investigational)

k_of_n.quote: ONE of the following: a. A minimum score of 30 points on the motor portion of the Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS) ... OR b. Parkinson disease for at least 4 years.

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: RNS has a contraindications clause inside the final ALL list: 'Do not have contraindications for RNS device placement (contradictions include 3 or more specific seizure foci, presence of primary generalized epilepsy, or presence of a rapidly progressive neurologic disorder).' Everything else is excluded by 'considered experimental or investigational'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Replacement pathway: 'Revision or replacement of an implanted neurostimulator meets the definition of medical necessity when all of the criteria above ... are met, the device is not functioning, and is no longer under warranty or cannot be repaired.' Also a NOTE: 'Pulse generator replacement can be expected and may be necessary 3 - 5 years following the initial placement'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Members with Parkinson disease and ALL of the following: A good response to levodopa; AND Motor complications not controlled by pharmacologic therapy; AND ONE of the following:
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Capitalised ALL, per-bullet AND and a nested ONE: clear, but the AND at the end of each bullet is redundant with the lead-in and must be ignored not parsed as an operator.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Unilateral or bilateral deep brain stimulation of the globus pallidus or subthalamic nucleus meets the definition of medical necessity for the following members: [Parkinson bullet] [dystonia bullet]
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Top-level bullets are alternatives but no OR is printed between them.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: all of the criteria above for deep brain stimulation or responsive neurostimulation are met
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'Above' is a positional reference spanning two separate pathways; which pathway applies depends on device type.

requirement_kinds.quote: disabling, medically unresponsive tremor due to essential tremor or Parkinson disease
A minimum score of 30 points on the motor portion of the Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS) when the member has been without medication for approximately 12 hours
Members seven (7) years of age or above with chronic, intractable (drug refractory) primary dystonia
Have an average of 3 or more disabling seizures ... per month over the prior 3 months;
Are refractory to medical therapy (have failed 2 or more appropriate antiepileptic medications at therapeutic doses);
Are not candidates for focal resective epilepsy surgery
Have a diagnosis of focal seizures with 1 or 2 well-localized seizure foci identified;
the device is not functioning, and is no longer under warranty or cannot be repaired

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: ICD-10 list 'Diagnosis Codes That Support Medical Necessity' (G20, G21, G24, G25.0, G40.x) is a single list, not mapped to a specific CPT or pathway.

an overall assessment rating tool used to follow the longitudinal course of Parkinson's disease

vague_terms.quote: Motor complications not controlled by pharmacologic therapy
vague_terms.problem: Not defined; which complications, what 'controlled' means.

vague_terms.quote: appropriate antiepileptic medications at therapeutic doses

extraction_hazards: Sub-headings 'Deep Brain Stimulation', 'Responsive Neurostimulation', 'Revision/Replacement' are plain lines without colon or numbering; only blank lines set them off.
Nested levels (bullet, nested bullet, a./b.) are distinguished only by indentation in the text.
'Revision/Replacement' refers to 'criteria above' with no anchor.
ICD-10 table has many G40.x rows whose long descriptions wrap onto a second line; HCPCS descriptions wrap similarly.
Definitions that carry a time window are 250 lines away from the criterion.
interesting_structures: Two device technologies and a revision rule in one document, each with its own pathway; the same 'meets/experimental' lead-in recurs per pathway.
Scale-based threshold (UPDRS motor 30 off medication) combined with a duration alternative.
Position statement indicates replacement re-uses 'all of the criteria above': coverage chained to the original criteria.

fit_to_tree.why: Pathways with all/any nesting map well, and leaves are mostly measurable. Strain: definitions that change thresholds, 'criteria above' reference, undefined clinical terms, and the need to know device type and hardware status (warranty).
